features.feature: Extract token-count-only usage from codex bounded provider runner (extractCodexUsage scanning OpenAI JSONL shape: prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/prompt_tokens_details)
Extract token-count-only usage from gemini bounded provider runner (extractGeminiUsage scanning Gemini usageMetadata: promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount/cachedContentTokenCount)
Add optional reportedUsage field to ProviderExecResult in providers/types.ts (token counts only, no raw transcript)
Raw-output-never-surfaced security invariant: only numeric token-count fields leave the provider runner, no transcript or credentials
Architecture invariant: providers/codex-cli.ts and providers/gemini-cli.ts must have zero imports from core/usage-ledger/
Add recordDispatchFinalForProvider canonical per-provider final-usage entry point in dispatch-usage.ts routing through buildProviderRecord for openai/gemini providers
recordDispatchFinalForProvider supersede semantics (supersedesRecordIds contains the estimate recordId)
recordDispatchFinalForProvider unavailable-fallback semantics when reportedUsage is null/undefined (writes usage.source=unavailable final that still supersedes estimate)
Existing recordDispatchFinal (anthropic/claude path) and parseClaudeCliOutput stay byte-identical -- no anthropic path change
No new cross-module imports in dispatch-usage.ts beyond existing usage-ledger siblings
Fail-open behavior for recordDispatchFinalForProvider: ledger errors must never break dispatch
provider.name mapping: codex hostKind maps to openai provider, gemini hostKind maps to gemini provider
Wire preflight estimate (recordDispatchPreflight) into runBoundedRealLeafDispatch before the bounded run when ledger is ON
Wire recordDispatchFinalForProvider into runBoundedRealLeafDispatch after the bounded run when ledger is ON
Ledger-OFF path byte-identical to pre-change behavior (no file writes, no directory creation)
Claude real-leaf path unchanged (no change to claude-code real-leaf path)
Smoke test: codex and gemini bounded runs through injected stub runner, asserts provider-reported final with correct token counts
Smoke wired into npm test (npm script + verifier wiring)
Budget-guard (fail-closed pre-spawn block) for codex/gemini dispatches
features.excluded_by: No budget-guard (fail-closed pre-spawn block) for codex/gemini -- deferred

features.feature: Authority receipt-backed signing of usage ledger records
Multi-provider normalization: usage.raw (raw provider units + payloadDigest) and usage.canonical {input, output, cacheCreation, cacheRead} on every provider-reported record
Privacy constraint: no raw prompt, transcript, provider secret, customer API key, actor key, or authorization header in ledger records (privacy field redactionProfile)
estimator fallback chain: provider count_tokens endpoint (high) -> local tokenizer (medium) -> bytes/chars heuristic (low, offline only) with confidence field
Ledger record four-field cache-token model: inputTokens (uncached remainder), outputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens -- null for providers not reporting cache dims
Story/phase attribution captured at preflight from active lease/session context (storyId, phase, agentType, subagentId)
Periodic reconciliation check: provider-dispatch events vs ledger final records keyed per ledgerCallId+attemptId to surface completeness gaps
Streaming usage captured from terminal stream event (message_delta/final message); mid-stream error still records partial provider-reported usage
Cost derivability: pricingRef reference on record, no absolute dollar amount stored; totals derived in summary layer not stored
